motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Press scale, reveal rises, dot scale, arrow and stack-name translation.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: The line drawing in on load, the statement line-rise, node open and close (500ms).

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Declared on :root; not used by any rule in the build.

motion.name: t-hover
motion.purpose: Colour and background swaps on hover, link underline fade.

motion.name: t-ui
motion.purpose: Dot colour and scale, stack note entry, arrow push.

motion.name: node-open
motion.purpose: grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr with ease-expo; inner visibility delayed 500ms on close.

motion.name: line-draw
motion.purpose: scaleY from 0 with ease-expo, 100ms delay, on load.

motion.name: line-up
motion.purpose: Statement lines rising through overflow masks, 110ms stagger starting at 250ms.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Hero intro and CTA rising 12px, delays 520ms and 620ms.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals: opacity 600ms and 20px translate 800ms, 90ms stagger per --i; list children 500/700ms, 70ms apart.

motion.name: pulse-track
motion.purpose: The fixed pulse following scroll progress; removed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: figure-roll
motion.purpose: Figures count from 0 to their real value once with a cubic ease-out, in script.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Axis moves to 1.125rem from the left edge, margin becomes 2.625rem, every grid collapses to one column padded calc(var(--axis) + 1.5rem).

narrative.overview:
One unbroken 4px line runs the full height of the page on a vertical axis at 42% of the viewport width, and everything Ajal has made hangs on it as a node. A fixed 140px blue pulse rides the line in step with the scroll; the node whose dot it passes opens. The page is almost entirely type: no imagery, no illustration, no card grid, no hero picture. Paper, ink, one grey for the past, and a single blue that belongs to the line and whatever the line is currently pointing at.

Density is low and the rhythm is long. Sections are separated by a vertical interval of 7 to 12rem, the hero leaves its upper 60% empty so the line can enter alone, and the sticky asides to the left of the axis hold one short paragraph each. Everything right of the axis sits exactly 1.5rem off it, which makes the line read as the left edge of the content rather than as decoration.

Interaction replaces decoration. Controls invert on hover (blue to ink, ink to paper), the open node's dot swells and turns blue, stack items slide a quarter-em to the right and disclose their note, contact rows invert whole and push their arrow. Everything is hard-edged and flat: square corners, flat fills, no shadows, no gradients, no hairlines. Confirmed rejections from the build: a dark ground, app screenshots or drawn phone fragments, a stretched wordmark, badges, and card layouts.
keyCharacteristics: One 4px line (`--line`) on a 42% axis (`--axis`), 1.125rem on screens under 64em; it is the only rule on the page.
A fixed 140px blue pulse rides the line with the scroll; the nearest node opens.
Accent blue appears only on the pulse, the open node, the primary button, focus rings, selection and hover.
One family, Chivo variable: 500 for the statement and all headings, 400 for text; sentence case throughout.
Flat, square, hairline-free. Alternating rows use a surface tint, never a border.
Every animation is gated behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`; the pulse is removed entirely under `reduce`.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue belongs to the pulse and to the thing the pulse is pointing at. At rest, exactly one node dot and one button carry it; everything else earns it only through hover, focus or selection. Never tint a background or a paragraph with it.

rules.name: The Invert Rule
rules.body: Hover and press do not lighten or glow; they swap ground and ink wholesale. Blue button to ink/paper, paper button to blue/white, paper row to ink/paper. Hover rules are wrapped in `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` so touch devices never see a stuck state.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Chivo at 500 for anything that names or declares (statement, headings, node names, buttons, figures, toggle text); 400 for anything you read. No other weight is used even though the file carries 100 to 900.

rules.name: The Tighter-As-It-Grows Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens with size: 0 at body and label, -0.02em at title, -0.03em at headline, -0.04em at display. Line-height closes the same way: 1.5, 1.2, 1, 0.95.

rules.name: The Off-Axis Rule
rules.body: Anything right of the line starts exactly 1.5rem from the axis, at every breakpoint. Alternating surface bands start at the axis plus the line's width so the line stays visible against them.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow, at rest or on hover. If a surface needs to separate, it takes the surface tint or inverts.

rules.name: The No-Hairline Rule
rules.body: The 4px line is the only rule on the page. Rows, lists and sections are never divided by borders; they are divided by the surface band or by whitespace.

dos: Do hang every new element on the axis: left column padded by `--margin` outside and 1.5rem inside, right column starting 1.5rem past the axis.
Do separate repeated rows with the surface tint on even rows, offset by the line's width so the line stays visible.
Do invert on hover (ground and ink swap) and keep hover rules inside `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
Do use Chivo 500 for names and headings and 400 for reading text, sentence case, with tracking from 0 to -0.04em as size grows.
Do set figures in tabular numerals and write the final value in the HTML before any rolling animation.
Do gate every animation behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and keep the page fully readable with no script (nodes open, line visible).
Do keep the accent to the pulse, the one open node, the primary button, focus, selection and hover.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, blurs or glows anywhere, including on hover.
Don't draw borders or hairlines; the 4px line is the only rule on the page.
Don't round a corner; every box, dot and button is square.
Don't introduce a second colour, a second family, uppercase labels, kickers or eyebrows above headings.
Don't add raster imagery, illustrations, app screenshots or drawn phone screens; the page is type and one line.
Don't return to a dark page ground; ink ground is reserved for the footer and for hover inversion.
Don't open more than one node at a time or let a node open without its dot turning blue.
